summary: uri options: ciphers, client_cert/client_key, creates guard, decompress, dest to download to, follow_redirects (safe default), and force to bypass cache.
questions: How do I download a file with the uri module?
How do I use mutual TLS with uri?
Does uri follow redirects for POST requests?
How do I skip a uri call if a file exists?

answer_card.title: uri download, TLS, redirects
answer_card.answer_md:
- `dest`: save response to path (dir → server basename)
- `client_cert`, `client_key`: mTLS
- `ciphers`
- `follow_redirects`: `safe` (default), `all`, `none`, `urllib2`
- `creates`, `force` (no cache), `decompress` (true)
